author: @Careermudhra_

content.text: Most students wonder after 12th, what course should they pursue that would help them in future. Such a course is BAMS – the Bachelor in Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery. It is a 5.5-year undergraduate degree program that moulds peers to become Ayurvedic specialists. Every willing student must qualify the NEET UG examination for BAMS admission. There are a total of 28 colleges for BAMS admission in Punjab. In this article, we will discuss in detail everything regarding BAMS in Punjab. It includes the admission process, eligibility, fee structure, top colleges and future career opportunities.

sections.heading: How to get BAMS Admission in Punjab

content.text: Generally the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test is mandatory for BAMS admission in Punjab. After qualifying the NEET UG, students must attend the online counselling session. Only thus do they get seat allotment at their preferred colleges. The Guru Ravidas Ayurved University, Hoshiarpur, conducts the Punjab BAMS counselling . The total seats of BAMS in Punjab is 950. Out of which 50 seats are provided at the government colleges, and the remaining 900 seats are in private colleges. These seats are divided into All India Quota (15%) and State Quota (85%). For all India quota seats, the counselling session is conducted by the counselling authority of AACCC .

sections.heading: BAMS Eligibility in Punjab

content.text: Students who are willing to get BAMS admission in Punjab must be aware of the eligibility criteria for this course. All over India, the requirements are pretty much the same. They are shared below.
Educational Eligibility

items: The willing students have to pass their 10+2 exams from a recognised board.
The willing students should have a science stream in their 10+2 curriculum. The required subject combination is Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
A minimum aggregate of 50% in the PCB subjects is a must. (40% for Reserved Candidates and 45% for PwD Candidates)

content.text: Entrance Examination

items: For BAMS admission in Punjab, NEET is mandatory. So, a promising percentile is required with qualification of the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG).

content.text: Age Requirement

items: All willing candidates must be aged 17 years or above at the time of admission.

sections.heading: BAMS Admission Process in Punjab

content.text: Students who are willing to take BAMS admission in Punjab need to follow some steps. The following is the whole step-by-step guide, for admission.
Step 1: Register for the NEET UG Examination from the official website of the National Testing Agency (NTA). And qualify the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test.

Step 2: Next, fill out the application form to attend the Punjab AYUSH Counselling. It is available on the website of the Guru Ravidas Ayurved University, Hoshiarpur . Provide all of your academic and personal information to submit the form.
Step 3: The login credentials will be sent to the email IDs of the candidates. Use them to log in during the counselling session on the online portal.
Step 4: While attending the counselling session, make your choice of preferred colleges to take admission in.
Step 5: The counselling authority will then publish a list of seat allotment. Candidates are allotted their seats; it depends on their NEET merit scores and seat availability at the college.
Step 6: Candidates should report to their allotted colleges after allotment. They must carry with them the necessary documents to complete the document verification.
Step 7: Lastly, to finalize the seat allotted, the selected students must pay the prescribed fees.

Note that for BAMS admission in Punjab, there are 4 counselling rounds (Round 1, Round 2, Mop-up Round, and Stray Vacancy Round). A candidate should wait for the next rounds if he/she doesn’t get their seat allotment at one round.

sections.heading: Top 10 BAMS Colleges in Punjab

content.text: There are 28 colleges that offer BAMS admission in Punjab. Both private and government colleges exist to sustain the need. While the government colleges have the best placement record and nourished faculty, the private ones promise the best infrastructure in the country. And, depending on the college type, the seat availability is different in each of them.

sections.heading: BAMS Fees in Punjab

content.text: The government of India and the Ministry of AYUSH have given the state governments’ independence to provide the BAMS course with their own fee structure. So, the government and private colleges’ BAMS fees in Punjab are different.

The private colleges have a higher fee structure than the government ones. Although the private ones charge extra, they also promise the best infrastructure and well-trained faculty. If a candidate wants the detailed fee structure, visit the official website of the respective college they wish to apply or connect with us.

BAMS Careers in Punjab

content.text: Primarily, students who complete their BAMS course can pursue a higher degree according to their preferred specialisation. The colleges of Punjab offer MS/MD and PhD in Ayurveda. So, the opportunities for higher study are plenty for BAMS. Also, for those who want to take up jobs after graduation, hospitals and nursing homes have many vacancies for them. The BAMS govt jobs in Punjab includes the following.

items: BAMS Doctor
Ayurvedic Consultants
Medical Officer
Ayurvedic Research Officer

content.text: Apart from these, students can become medical practitioners, as it is currently trending in the BAMS jobs in Punjab. The Punjab government has promised a lot of career prospects as Govt jobs for BAMS doctors in Punjab is increasing.

sections.heading: Conclusion

content.text: There are 950 BAMS vacancy in Punjab – 50 government seats and 900 private seats. All these seats are also divided into state quota, all-India quota, and NRI quota. Although NEET is mandatory for BAMS admission in Punjab, securing a seat in a government college solely depends on the decision of the counselling authority, which is the Guru Ravidas Ayurved University.
